text:
zoe: Quick announcement: we're changing the .NET SDK async generator return type to IAsyncEnumerable<T> in the next major to improve streaming ergonomics. Putting up a 120-day compatibility window with a compatibility shim.

hiro: Is this breaking for customers using older frameworks? We'll need to call this out clearly.

zoe: Yes — frameworks that do not support IAsyncEnumerable (pre-.NET Core 3.0) will need the shim. We'll keep the old method signatures behind a compiler-flag and emit Obsolete warnings for 120 days, then remove in 365 days.

brad: Eng plan: publish v3.0-preview with both signatures behind #if LEGACY_ASYNC, add analyzer that flags usage of legacy API and suggests migration. CI will validate both code paths for 4 months. We'll also provide NuGet package `Redwood.AsyncShim` for legacy runtimes.

docs-bot: Published: docs PR #4352 by tasha - "dotnet: async streaming migration guide (WIP)" (automated).

tasha: Docs tasks: update API reference, add migration snippets for common patterns (foreach await, ToAsyncEnumerable adapters), and top-banner deprecation notice on .NET SDK page. ETA: Friday EOD draft.

hiro: Support asks: 1) short TL;DR for support and sales, 2) sample rollback (install Redwood.AsyncShim), 3) list of customers on runtimes < netcore3.0. I'll export the customer list and share privately.

zoe: Timeline summary: today - announce + publish preview; 120 days - compatibility warnings and stronger docs; 365 days - remove legacy signatures. We'll coordinate blog + customer emails.

tasha: Migration example for docs:
```csharp
// legacy
public IEnumerable<Token> StreamTokens(Request req) { ... }

// new (recommended)
public async IAsyncEnumerable<Token> StreamTokensAsync(Request req) {
  foreach (var t in await FetchTokens(req))
    yield return t;
}
```
Notes: Use `await foreach` to consume. For older runtimes, install `Redwood.AsyncShim` and keep legacy calls for a limited window.

brad: Ops: for Dedicated, we'll ship runtime images with shim preinstalled for 12 months and add a warning in logs when legacy API is used.

tasha: I'll add a small FAQ: detection, rollback, examples, and analyzer link. Posting the RFC and final PR link when merged. :thumbsup:
